## Core algorithm vs. Manly-Jones

```{r}
a1_crosstab_data(a1_tab_mj_core, "Core") |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ sub("^Comparator class: ", "Core: ", .x)) |>
  gt::gt(rowname_col = "Manly-Jones class") |>
  gt::tab_stubhead("Manly-Jones class") |>
  gt::cols_align("center") |>
  a2_2_gt_style(font = 22, width = 90)
```

<div style="font-size: 0.5em; line-height: 1.25;">

- Of participants with dementia by the Manly-Jones algorithm, `r a1_pct(a1_agree$capture_core, 0)`% have dementia by the core algorithm.
- Of participants with dementia by the core algorithm, `r a1_pct(a1_agree$ppv_core, 0)`% have dementia by the Manly-Jones algorithm.
- Kappa: three-class `r a1_dec(a1_agree$kappa_core)`; dementia vs. not `r a1_dec(a1_agree$kappa_core_bin)`.

</div>

<div style="font-size: 0.4em; line-height: 1.2;">
`r a2_2_weighted_thousands_note` Row percentages in parentheses. N = `r a1_n(a1_n_agree)` HRS-HCAP Wave 1 participants with both classifications (HCAP16WGTR). Appendix 1, Tables A4 and A5.
</div>
